Date: Wed, 11 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Confidential — performance-related conduct concern

Ben,

This is hard to write, so I wanted to be clear and confidential. Over the last six weeks I've had multiple instances where Rohan (my manager) publicly criticized my work in weekly calls and made a comment last Friday that implied my promotion potential was tied to doing personal favors for his network. I felt humiliated in front of the team and a couple of external partners (Jamie Smith from Acme was on the call).

I saved two screenshots (attached) and can share names of others who witnessed the comments. I'm requesting HR involvement and that this be handled confidentially — I am worried about retaliation. I do not want Rohan to be notified by me directly at this stage.

I appreciate any guidance on next steps.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor

Forwarding Neha's note and attaching a short timeline I pulled together from Slack and the last two weekly calls. Neha asked for confidentiality and expressed fear of retaliation; she explicitly asked that Rohan not be notified by her.

My read: the comments are serious enough to require immediate HR triage. I recommend we do two things while HR assesses:
- Place a precautionary reassignment so Rohan is not Neha's direct reviewer for the next 2 weeks (reassign to Rachel for interim 1:1s).
- Issue a no-contact reminder between Rohan and Neha pending intake.

Attachments: timeline-summary.pdf, witness-list.xlsx

I'll coordinate with you, Monica, on logistics and preserve the Slack threads. Please confirm and let me know if Legal should be looped now or after intake.

Ben Carter

Ben / Neha — thanks for bringing this to People Ops, Ben, and thank you for telling us directly, Neha. This will be handled as a confidential conduct review. To be transparent about process and timeline:

1) A People Ops intake meeting — I'll schedule a 30-minute confidential call with Neha today or tomorrow to capture details and collect evidence.
2) Preservation request — please preserve all Slack threads, calendar invites, and call recordings related to the dates in the attached timeline. Do not delete messages.
3) Interim measures — I agree with the precautionary reassignment and no-contact directive while we do the intake. Ben, please implement reassigning Neha's 1:1s to Rachel immediately and block back-channel feedback.
4) Witnesses — Neha, if you're comfortable, please share the witness list (I've seen the attached spreadsheet). We will reach out to witnesses individually and keep notes.
5) Legal — I'll loop Legal if the intake suggests potential policy or employment law implications. For now, Legal can be on standby (hr-legal@externalcounsel.com).

Neha — I want to reiterate: we will follow non-retaliation procedures. If you experience any escalation or change in your work assignments tied to this report, tell me immediately.
